events.name: Gay’s N Gameboards
events.description:
The Lounge goes full game night — tables flipped from cocktail mode to competition mode, cards shuffling, dice rolling, and Catan empires rising and falling before midnight. Alejandro's running the room, stirring up friendly chaos and making sure nobody leaves without at least one rematch demanded.

Stack up your favorite classics or dive into the deep stuff — strategy, trading, a little betrayal if the board calls for it. Come solo and find your new game-night crew, or roll in with your people and prove once and for all who's the real winner at the table.

Drinks flowing, playlist humming, Lounge lit low and easy — just enough mood to make losing sting a little less. Grab a seat, pick your weapon of choice, and let's see who's still undefeated by last call.

🗓️ Jueves 12 de noviembre — Show 8:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover Free

events.name: Freaketonas
events.description:
Fridays just got a new name. Freaketonas is Azúcar's new weekly night, every Friday from 9pm to close, with DJ Ralphy-Ray running the room on perreo, dembow, house and Latin hits. Vibras latinas start to finish: the kind of night where you come out, dance until they turn the lights on, and leave with your voice gone.

Drink specials all night: Mexican candy cocktails, tequila cocktails, and spiked horchata for the ones who know. Plus the full food menu if you need something to keep you going.

No cover. 21+. Doors at 9pm.

Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA 99301.

🗓️ Viernes 20 de noviembre — Show 9:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover No cover

events.name: Paint and Sip with Artwithaubrey
events.description:
Snowmen don't usually get this messy — or this cozy. Pull up a seat in the Ranchero Room as Art With Aubrey leads a step-by-step sip and paint session built for total beginners and secret Picassos alike. Sip something warm (or strong), follow along, and watch a tipsy little snowman come to life on your canvas.

No pressure, no perfection — just good company, holiday cheer, and a few happy accidents along the way. Aubrey keeps it light, funny, and easy to follow, so whether your lines are shaky or you've got hidden talent, you'll walk out with a one-of-a-kind masterpiece and a buzz to match.

Come solo, bring your crew, or make it a date night — easels are set, drinks are flowing, and the holiday spirit is very much alive. Silly, sweet, and a little bit sloppy, this is cozy season at Azúcar.

🗓️ Domingo 22 de noviembre — Show 6:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover $33

events.name: Build Your Own Carabiner Night
events.description:
Pull up a seat in the Lounge and get your hands busy — this is Build Your Own Carabiner Night, Azúcar style. Jayme's got the table loaded with charms, beads, and holiday trinkets so you can craft a carabiner or bracelet that's completely, unapologetically yours. No skills required, just vibes and good company.

This one's about slowing down and connecting — swap stories with the people next to you, admire somebody's bead combo, maybe steal the idea. It's community time wrapped in glitter and little silver clasps, the kind of night where strangers become friends over a shared pile of charms.

Grab a cocktail, settle in, and let your hands do something pretty while Jayme keeps the room warm and welcoming. Walk out with a one-of-a-kind piece and a few new faces in your corner — plus the inside scoop on what's coming up next at Azúcar.

December 6th, 7PM, Lounge. Bring your creativity — we'll bring the beads and the buzz.

🗓️ Domingo 6 de diciembre — Show 7:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover $10

🎟️ Tickets: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/build-your-own-carabiner-night-tickets-2004512928128

events.name: Sip and Paint with ArtwithAubrey
events.description:
Forget blank canvases and pressure — this is sip-and-paint season, Azúcar style. Pull up a seat in the Ranchero Room while Art With Aubrey walks you through decorating your very own set of Christmas bulbs, one sip and one brushstroke at a time. No art degree required, just a little holiday chispa and a drink in hand.

Aubrey's got the instruction and inspiration covered, so whether you're painting a tiny masterpiece or something delightfully chaotic, you'll leave with ornaments nobody else has and a tree that actually looks like you. Glitter, color, a little sparkle in your glass — it's festive, it's forgiving, and it's made for laughing at your own art.

Come solo, bring your people, make it a date night — every bulb, every brushstroke, every body welcome. December 6th at 6pm, Ranchero Room. Come paint, sip, and deck your tree the Azúcar way.
